<<On Path Of A Milk Delivery Round This Season>>  
The milk delivery round begins at 7 AM, winding through the neighborhood to ensure each family receives fresh milk. The driver, Maria, stops at the school, then the grocery store, and finally the elderly residents’ homes. This route covers 15 blocks, with each stop emphasizing community care. The round ends at 10 AM, leaving a warm, fresh scent in the air. It’s a vital part of the neighborhood’s daily routine, bringing comfort and nourishment to all.
